experience_role_merge_user_decision_chec.name: experience_role_merge_user_decision_check
experience_role_merge_user_decision_chec.value: ("experience_role_merge_proposals"."state" = 'proposed' AND "experience_role_merge_proposals"."decided_by_user_at" IS NULL) OR ("experience_role_merge_proposals"."state" <> 'proposed' AND "experience_role_merge_proposals"."decided_by_user_at" IS NOT NULL)

resume_assignments_exact_scope_check.name: resume_assignments_exact_scope_check
resume_assignments_exact_scope_check.value: ("resume_assignments"."scope" = 'default' AND "resume_assignments"."career_path_id" IS NULL AND "resume_assignments"."job_posting_id" IS NULL) OR ("resume_assignments"."scope" = 'path' AND "resume_assignments"."career_path_id" IS NOT NULL AND "resume_assignments"."job_posting_id" IS NULL) OR ("resume_assignments"."scope" = 'job' AND "resume_assignments"."career_path_id" IS NULL AND "resume_assignments"."job_posting_id" IS NOT NULL)
